audit_metadata.scope: v12 MOFA+v11 architectural change causal re-audit

section1_dag.mofa_factor_construction: mofapy2 K_requested=32, K_effective=29 ARD-pruned, single-view Gaussian on log1p(TPM) top-5000 HVG at MMRF enrollment baseline (t=0). No treatment-time expression used. No outcome labels in factorization.
section1_dag.mofa_temporal_position: PRE-TREATMENT baseline covariate. Deterministic linear function of baseline expression Z_bio at t=0. Causally upstream of treatment assignment A.

F_MOFA.causal_role: baseline confounder / proxy for unmeasured U

M_mediator.sibling_of: F_MOFA (both children of Z_bio baseline expression)

U_unmeasured.paths: U -> A, U -> M, U -> Y (all back-door paths not fully blocked)

section1_dag.key_finding: MOFA factors are pre-treatment baseline covariates — NOT mediators, NOT descendants of treatment, NOT colliders. They are sibling summaries of the same baseline expression space that generates M_proteasome.

identification_assumptions_v12: A1*: No unmeasured confounding A->Y given (C, F)
A2*: No unmeasured confounding A->M given (C, F)
A3*: No unmeasured confounding M->Y given (A, C, F)
A4: No exposure-induced mediator-outcome confounder [unchanged - F pre-treatment]
section2_nie_rederivation.backdoor_path_reasoning: F is upstream of A (pre-treatment). Adjusting for pre-treatment covariates never induces collider bias on the A->Y path (Robins 2003). F and M share parent Z_bio but conditioning on F while M is in the model is not a collider structure.

partial_proxy_blocking.claim: Conditioning on F partially proxies U via shared baseline expression
partial_proxy_blocking.estimated_U_proxy_fraction: 3-5% of prognostic variance beyond existing C features

tipping_pair_that_nullifies_lower_ci.interpretation: A confounder with joint (RR_AU=1.5, RR_UY=1.10) nullifies the lower-CI bound. ISS stage III, del17p, LDH routinely display these strengths in MM.

section3_f10_evalue_reestimate.delta_hr_required: +0.10 on the log-hazard scale (NIE lower CI from 1.029 to 1.13)
reasoning: The +0.021 ΔC from MOFA is too small to close the (1.5, 1.10) tipping gap. MOFA proxies only ~3-5% of residual prognostic variance; the tipping confounder strengths remain plausible after conditioning on F.
F10 failure confirmed STRUCTURAL across all 7 mediator panels (RUNS.md row 20). MOFA is a covariate enrichment, not a mediator re-definition.
MOFA factors and M_proteasome share parent Z_bio. Conditioning on F may attenuate beta_M|C*, potentially REDUCING the NIE point estimate rather than raising it.
No new paired (z0,z1) data is introduced. The confounding structure in U is not resolved by baseline expression summarization alone.
section3_f10_evalue_reestimate.verdict: F10 STRUCTURAL FAIL persists under v12. E-value threshold of 1.5 not reachable.

conditions_for_L1_to_L2_promotion.F10_evalue_ge_1p5: FAIL - structural, not resolved by v12 MOFA

conditions_for_L2_to_L3_promotion.F8_DPS_per_patient_drift: STRICT FAIL - 0/16 cells under both v10 single-Euler and v11 Neural-ODE operators (RUNS.md rows 23, 25). N_paired=29 < Stone(d=64)~150. MOFA does not provide new paired data.

section4_pearl_tier_ceiling.v12_mofa_causal_content: None beyond L1. The +0.021 marginal ΔC is a concordance-statistic difference on observed (X,Y) pairs. No do-operator, no counterfactual, no identification of causal path.
section4_pearl_tier_ceiling.load_bearing_datum_preserved: v10 Sprint 7 F8 STRICT FAIL (0/16 cells; ED_prior~ED_const; best p_vs_const=0.432) is operator-independent and unaffected by v12 MOFA.

flag_1.assessment: SAFE at L1. 'Orthogonal signal' is statistical. No intervention claimed.

flag_2.assessment: SAFE at L1 with hedge required in manuscript use.

runs_md_row_37.assessment: No L2 language detected. Marginal C-index, bootstrap CI, and pre-registered verdicts stated without causal overreach.
